title: Reiwa no Dara-san

thread.title: Dara-san of Reiwa • Reiwa no Dara-san - Episode 7 discussion

opinions.point: Several commenters enjoyed the show's blend of unsettling horror, comedy, and sudden tonal shifts.
The central characters were widely found entertaining and emotionally engaging, especially Dara-san's personality and the family reactions.
Commenters appreciated the episode's emotional weight and humorous reversals without considering them inconsistent with the series' identity.
Some discussion expressed concern that the remaining backstory may need careful pacing to fit within the cour.

notes: The title and body explicitly identify Reiwa no Dara-san, episode 7. Comments were retrieved from this thread only and paraphrased without plot details. The page did not expose reliable score metadata, so score is reported as 0.
